rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an electric light bulb.

example.english: This bulb is about to burn out.
example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 dang1 daam2 zau6 lai4 waai6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the underground bulb of a plant such as a tulip, especially in gardening contexts.

example.english: I bought a tulip bulb and will plant it in a flowerpot later.
example.traditional: 我買咗一粒鬱金香球根，遲啲種落花盆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 nap1 juk1 gam1 hoeng1 kau4 gan1 ci4 di1 zung3 lok6 faa1 pun4
